notes.about: One thing a member said while planning the red team drone sim: an answer, idea, open question or decision, filed under one of the stages. Shown on that stage's page, decisions first.

fields.stage: string, which part it is about: challenge, drone, environment or camera
fields.text: string, what they said, like 'Start with the urban 4x4 block scenario'
fields.prompt: string, optional id of the starting question it answers, like drone-airframe
fields.done: boolean, true once a question is settled

plan.about: The group's single plan record: which stage they are focusing on now.

fields.focus: string, the stage in focus: drone, environment or camera

scenes.about: One saved world for the environment sim: the ground, light and altitude a member set up, so the drone and camera stages can fly over exactly the same ground. May carry the altitude sweep measured on it, drawn as a line on the features-by-altitude chart.

fields.name: string, what the world is, like 'Dead grass at dusk, with snow patches'
fields.surface: string, the ground: lawn, deadgrass, gravel, asphalt, snow, floor or site
fields.light: string, the light: noon, low, overcast, dusk, flood, dark (city sky glow only) or hall (indoors, hall lights)
fields.altitude: number, metres above ground the camera was at, like 30
fields.patches: boolean, whether low-texture patches (snow, bare floor) were laid over the ground
fields.shadow: boolean, whether the drone's own shadow was drawn
fields.seed: integer, the random seed that makes this exact ground, like 2111
fields.sweep: array, optional altitude sweep: objects like {alt: 30, features: 1800, coverage: 0.62}, coverage being the share of the 720p frame with enough FAST corners to track

flights.about: One result a member put on the hold board from the drone sim: either a 60 s hold trial at one altitude, or a ceiling search that flew every altitude rung and kept the highest that held. Sorted on the board by pass first, then altitude.

fields.kind: string, hold (one trial) or ceiling (a search over altitude rungs)
fields.world: string, name of the ground flown over, like 'Dead grass, low November sun'
fields.surface: string, the ground: lawn, deadgrass, gravel, asphalt, snow, floor or site
fields.light: string, the light: noon, low, overcast, dusk, flood, dark (city sky glow only) or hall (indoors, hall lights)
fields.seed: integer, the seed of that ground, like 2111
fields.patches: boolean, whether low-texture patches were on
fields.altitude: number, metres held (for a ceiling, the highest rung that passed, 0 if none), like 30
fields.gnss: string, GNSS mode: full, degraded, spoofed or denied
fields.vio: boolean, whether VIO from the nadir camera was on
fields.tune: string, VIO quality assumed: typical, tuned or best
fields.wind: number, mean wind at 10 m in m/s, like 4
fields.gust: string, gustiness: calm, moderate or strong
fields.radius: number, pass radius in metres, like 1
fields.max_drift: number, worst horizontal distance from the hold point in metres, like 0.84
fields.mean_drift: number, average distance from the hold point in metres, like 0.4
fields.inside: number, share of the time inside the pass radius, 0 to 1
fields.passed: boolean, true when the worst drift stayed inside the radius
fields.vio_lost: number, seconds VIO had lost tracking
fields.gnss_rejections: integer, times the fusion threw GNSS out for disagreeing with VIO
fields.coverage: number, average share of the 720p frame with trackable features, 0 to 1
fields.events: array of strings, what was switched during the trial, like '12 s GNSS denied'
fields.rungs: array, for a ceiling: objects like {alt: 30, max_drift: 0.9, coverage: 0.55, passed: true}

cameras.about: One camera setup a member saved in the camera sim: the Justice D's readout time, exposure, mount and lens settings, so the group tests the same simulated camera. Carries what the sim measured with it at save time.

fields.name: string, what the setup is, like 'Justice D, hard mount, dusk'
fields.readout_ms: number, rolling shutter readout time top row to bottom in milliseconds, 0 for a global shutter, like 13
fields.exposure_ms: number, fixed exposure in milliseconds, or 0 for auto exposure, like 4
fields.mount: string, how the camera is mounted: soft (damped), hard, or loose (a loose mount or chipped prop)
fields.lens: boolean, whether wide lens barrel distortion and vignetting are on
fields.noise: boolean, whether sensor noise is on
fields.result: object, measured at save time: {altitude: metres, warp: worst rolling shutter warp in 720p pixels over 2 s, blur: motion blur in pixels, features: FAST corners in the 720p frame}, like {altitude: 20, warp: 1.4, blur: 0.6, features: 820}

benchmarks.about: One benchmark run a member shared from the real-site page: the same 60 s GNSS-denied hold flown at 10, 30, 60 and 100 m over the Ottawa farm orthophoto and over a textured world, with features and drift side by side.

fields.site: string, the real site, like 'Central Experimental Farm, Ottawa'
fields.world: string, the textured world it was compared with, like 'Dead grass, low November sun'
fields.radius: number, pass radius in metres, like 1
fields.rows: array of objects, one per altitude: alt (m), site_features, site_coverage (0-1), site_drift (worst m), site_mean (m), field_features, field_coverage, field_drift, field_mean

missions.about: One mission a member shared from the Mission screen: a 60 s hold over one site with one camera setup. Listed newest first, and can be flown again. The worst night test shares one record per rung, climbing each evening condition until the hold drifts out. Losing the lock shares one record per cut length (1, 3, 6, 10 and 20 s), flown without and then with the lost-lock fallback, with how long VIO and the hold took to come back.

fields.site: string, which ground: farm (Ottawa farm aerial photo), delft (Delft old town), dubendorf (Dübendorf airfield), andermatt (alpine slope above Andermatt) or textured (a generated world), like dubendorf
fields.site_name: string, the site's name, like Dübendorf airfield, Zürich
fields.camera_name: string, the camera setup's name, like Justice D, our 13 ms guess
fields.readout_ms: number, line readout time of the whole frame in ms, 0 is global shutter, like 13
fields.exposure_ms: number, fixed exposure in ms, 0 for auto, like 0
fields.mount: string, soft, hard or loose, like hard
fields.lens: boolean, wide lens distortion on, like true
fields.altitude: number, hold height in metres, like 20
fields.gnss: string, full, degraded, spoofed or denied, like denied
fields.tune: string, typical, tuned or best, like typical
fields.rs_aware: boolean, whether VIO models the rolling shutter, like false
fields.wind: number, mean wind in m/s, like 4
fields.radius: number, pass radius in metres, like 1
fields.max_drift: number, worst distance from the mark in metres, like 0.84
fields.mean_drift: number, average distance from the mark in metres, like 0.31
fields.inside: number, share of the time inside the radius, 0 to 1, like 0.97
fields.passed: boolean, stayed inside the radius the whole time, like true
fields.features_rs: number, average corners VIO tracked per rolling shutter frame, like 180
fields.features_gs: number, the same with a global shutter, like 196
fields.coverage: number, average share of frame cells with trackable corners, 0 to 1, like 0.42
fields.warp_px: number, average rolling shutter warp in 720p pixels, like 1.3
fields.blur_px: number, average motion blur in 720p pixels, like 0.6
fields.vio_lost: number, seconds VIO was lost, like 0
fields.events: string, what was changed mid-flight, like 12 s: GNSS denied
fields.anchor: boolean, whether the hold matched each frame against the frame seen at the mark, so VIO drift could not pile up, like true
fields.nav_err: number, worst distance in metres between where the drone believed it was and where it really was, like 1.4
fields.ctrl_err: number, worst distance in metres between where the drone believed it was and the mark, from wind and control, like 0.35
fields.test: string, the named test: 'ottawa' (tracker tuning on the farm), 'night' (worst night ladder) or 'recovery' (tracking cut mid-hold); absent otherwise
fields.tracker: object, VIO tracker settings: {name, threshold (grey levels), minDist (px), maxFeatures, levels (pyramid), contrast}, like {name: 'Default', threshold: 12, minDist: 3, maxFeatures: 3456, levels: 1, contrast: 1}
fields.condition: string, for the worst night only, which evening it flew: grass_dusk, grass_dark, patchy_flood, snow_dusk, snow_flood or hall_floor, like snow_flood
fields.cut_s: number, recovery: seconds tracking was cut, 15 s in, like 3 (1, 3, 6, 10 or 20)
fields.reacquire_s: number, recovery: seconds after the cut until VIO tracked again, absent if never, like 1.3
fields.recover_s: number, recovery: seconds after the cut until inside the radius for 3 s, 0 if it never left, absent if not, like 4.2
fields.recovered: boolean, recovery: settled back inside the radius before the hold ended, like true
fields.fallback: boolean, whether the lost-lock fallback was on: when tracking is lost it holds still on the IMU, then finds the mark again (climbing if needed) and flies back; absent means off, like true

lessons.about: One lesson a member finished on the Learn path (from how drones and cameras work to what the challenge asks). The path ticks off each member's lessons and shows who in the group finished each one.

fields.lesson: string, the lesson's id: challenge, flight, position, camera, shutter, vio, height, recovery, oursim or next

measurements.about: One measurement the group took of the real M2-AI, Justice D or APB, on the Measure page. The newest record for each item is the value shown and, for airframe and camera items, what 'Put into the sim' applies.

fields.item: string, what was measured: mass, inertia, readout, lens, camimu, imu, thrust, lag, hover, vibe, drag, ram or viotime
fields.inputs: object, the raw readings typed in, by key, like {hz: 1000, period: 55, rows: 720} for readout
fields.result: object, the worked-out values, like {ms: 13.1, line_us: 18.2} for readout, {mass: 2.95} for mass, {roll: 0.03, pitch: 0.03, yaw: 0.05} for inertia in kg m², {n: 24.5} for thrust in N, {s: 0.035} for lag, {quad: 0.05} for drag
fields.note: string, optional remark, like 'second try with new strings'

github.about: The viewer's GitHub repos: make one, push the sim's source to it.
